steps.en: Install the CLI and log in with Colab scopes once
steps.zh: 装好 CLI，用带 Colab 权限的账号登录一次
steps.code: uv tool install google-colab-cli · gcloud auth application-default login

steps.en: Run a local script on the accelerator you name
steps.zh: 指定加速器，运行本地脚本

steps.en: Reserves a Colab VM with that GPU and connects to its Jupyter kernel
steps.zh: 向 Colab 预订一台带该 GPU 的虚拟机，连上它的 Jupyter 内核

steps.en: Sends your file with its args into the kernel and streams output back
steps.zh: 把本地文件连同参数送进内核执行，输出实时流回终端

steps.en: Releases the VM when the script ends, even on error, and returns its exit code
steps.zh: 脚本结束即释放虚拟机，出错也释放，并返回退出码

value.en: A Colab GPU run becomes one terminal command a script or agent can issue — no browser tab to paste into, no idle VM left burning compute units
value.zh: 一次 Colab GPU 运行变成脚本或 agent 能发的一条命令——不用往浏览器贴代码，也不会留下空转烧钱的虚拟机

sources: https://github.com/googlecolab/google-colab-cli README (uv tool install google-colab-cli; colab run --gpu T4 train.py; Ephemeral Accelerator Jobs)
skills/colab-operator/SKILL.md (gcloud auth application-default login with Colab scopes; colab run = new + exec + stop, exit codes propagate, self-cleans on error)
docs/05_run_command.md (Allocate via assign, execute script body in kernel with sys.argv, unassign in finally)
